selection_note: Only the requirement-backed, positive login test is selected for live execution. Other generated cases remain review_required or depend on an authenticated-session fixture not yet represented by the execution CLI.

test_cases.title: Public-demo login opens Dashboard
preconditions: The public OrangeHRM demo login page is open.
The page visibly publishes demo Username Admin and Password admin123.

steps.action: Enter Admin in the Username textbox.
Enter admin123 in the Password textbox.
steps.expected: The Password textbox contains the entered value.
Dashboard opens at /web/index.php/dashboard/index and the Dashboard heading is visible.

test_cases.expected_result: Dashboard opens at https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/dashboard/index and a Dashboard heading is visible.
